decisions.reason: As a close-to-core seasonal product that the firm explicitly framed as a flagship, its continued presence suggests performance at least near aspiration despite a less prominent 2024 display, so management would likely keep it unless the next season disappoints clearly.
This bread stayed on its own page across both years and fits the firm's traditional bakery capabilities very closely, indicating results likely meet aspiration levels and justify retaining it.

Its continued dedicated presentation over two years and strong fit with the firm's confectionery and holiday assortment imply acceptable performance relative to aspirations, though seasonal concentration leaves some moderate risk of later rationalisation.
